A count here may FALL freely (an engine shipped a rung). A count that RISES fails.
Regenerate ONLY for a deliberate coverage change, and say so in the commit: a skip
count that drifts upward one unremarkable commit at a time stops meaning anything.

is the 'I added coverage and the skip count went up' case skip_ratchet.py's header says has to be said
out loud. The part pins a clause that predates it — SPEC §3.1 ⟨0.24⟩, `whatif` over an incomplete
report OMITS `ok` — against the THREE causes of incompleteness added since (⟨0.30⟩ outOfScope, ⟨0.32⟩
unread class, ⟨0.33⟩ cross-policy). MEASURED at HEAD: candor-java carries all three; candor-scan
carries two and answers `ok: false` on cross-policy; candor-ts carries none; candor-swift ships no
`whatif` verb at all (its `ALL ACTIONS` line has nine and this is not one).
THE CELLS ARE PER CAUSE, NOT PER ENGINE, which is why there are four cause lines and not two. candor-
scan already withdraws `ok` for ⟨0.30⟩ and ⟨0.32⟩; a per-engine SKIP would have parked those two
PASSING cells behind one line and stopped watching them — the never-shipped / un-shipped confusion this
file exists to prevent, arriving through the granularity of a row instead of through its absence.
THE PROBES ARE STRICTLY WEAKER THAN THE CELLS THEY GUARD, which is what keeps a parked cell honest. A
cause cell skips only when that engine's `whatif` emits NO `incomplete` key at all; an engine that
emits `incomplete: true` and leaves `ok: false` standing beside it is SCORED and FAILS — the fail-open
half, the same way PART 69 scores an engine shipping the producer half without the consumer half.
FALSIFIED rather than argued: a `CANDOR_QUERY_BIN` shim adding `incomplete: true` to candor-scan's
`whatif` documents and touching nothing else turned the parked rust cross-policy cell from SKIP to
`FAIL ok is PRESENT (false)`. A second shim, deleting `ok` unconditionally, reddened BOTH over-charge
controls while the cause cells stayed parked — so a port that lands the withdrawal by deleting the
feature cannot pass through the parking. Both shims removed.
EACH LINE FALLS TO 0 AS ITS ENGINE PORTS THAT CAUSE, and the entry must then be DELETED, not left at 1
— a baseline of 1 over an actual 0 lets a later un-ship rise to 1 and pass, the trap the 2026-08-21 and
